text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder tramples her<n>competition in the
Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Frustrated with the result, El Condor<n>Pasa
challenges her to a rematch at<n>the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But this would warrant a change in<n>our agenda.
While Grass Wonder<n>ponders the idea, we're
approached<n>by Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She taunts Grass Wonder by saying<n>El Condor
Pasa may be more<n>deserving of the moniker
"Beast's<n>Successor," then leaves.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Not one to take that lying down, Grass<n>Wonder
decides to accept El Condor<n>Pasa's challenge.
